name: Foolishness
overview: Scripture clearly identifies foolishness as a heart condition marked by a rejection of God and His wisdom, exemplified by those who say in their hearts there is no God and who despise instruction. True knowledge begins with the fear of the LORD, while fools trust in their own hearts and reject understanding. The fool openly reveals all his thoughts without restraint, contrasting with the wisdom of restraint and reliance on God rather than on man. Ultimately, trusting in oneself apart from God leads to folly, but walking wisely in dependence on Him brings deliverance.
